[[Deadly Crypt Spider]]s are foes that are encountered in [[the Catacombs]] in [[pre-Searing Ascalon]]. They spawn from the ceiling, as if dropping down on a web, and they share the same appearance as [[Spider]].

==Locations==
*[[Ascalon (pre-Searing)]]
**{{NPC location|The Catacombs}}

==Skills==
''None''

==Items dropped==
*[[Spider Leg]]
*[[Spider Web (Prophecies)|Spider Web]]

==Notes==
*According to the Prima Official Guide, this creature has an overall armor level of 9 and does 1-2 piercing damage.
{{Anomaly|Even though the attacks of these spiders are green indicating poison, they do not inflict any conditions.}}
